batteryarchive.cells: Sandia, CALCE, Oxford, HNEI, UL-PUR and others, re-served uniformly
batteryarchive.citation: Cite the originating laboratory, not the aggregator.
batteryarchive.license: per contributing dataset - verify per file
batteryarchive.name: Battery Archive (aggregator)
batteryarchive.notes: Best first target: already normalised to one CSV layout across laboratories, with per-cell metadata. Set --chemistry and --nominal-ah per batch, since they vary by cell.

calce.cells: 5 cell types: INR18650-20R 2.0Ah NMC/graphite, A123 1.1Ah LFP, CS2 1.1Ah prismatic LCO, CX2 1.35Ah prismatic LCO, PL 1.5Ah pouch LCO
calce.citation: CALCE Battery Research Group, University of Maryland.
calce.license: research use - verify at landing page
calce.name: CALCE battery cycling data
calce.notes: Set --nominal-ah per cell type; they differ (1.1 / 1.35 / 1.5 / 2.0 Ah). Arbin exports as Excel, so convert to CSV for the sniffer. CS2_8 and CS2_21 came off a CADEX tester and ship as .txt instead. Campaigns go well beyond plain cycling: low-current and incremental OCV at 0/25/45 C, DST/US06/FUDS drive cycles, pulsed-discharge profiles, temperature cycling 25-55 C, and partial-SOC ageing with periodic full characterisation. Cite the CALCE article for the experiment, not just the page.
calce.publisher: Center for Advanced Life Cycle Engineering, U. Maryland

nasa-pcoe.cells: 18650 LCO, ~2 Ah, charge/discharge/impedance at several temperatures
nasa-pcoe.citation: Saha, B. and Goebel, K. Battery Data Set, NASA Prognostics Data Repository, NASA Ames Research Center.
nasa-pcoe.license: US Government work, public domain - verify at landing page
nasa-pcoe.name: NASA PCoE battery data sets
nasa-pcoe.notes: Includes EIS sweeps alongside cycling. Those belong in eis_spectrum, not timeseries_record - this script skips them rather than flattening them into a time series.
nasa-pcoe.publisher: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence

oxford-2017.cells: 8 x Kokam SLPB533459H4, LCO/NCO pouch, 0.74 Ah
oxford-2017.citation: Birkl, C. Oxford Battery Degradation Dataset 1. University of Oxford (2017).
oxford-2017.license: CC BY - verify at landing page
oxford-2017.name: Oxford Battery Degradation Dataset 1
oxford-2017.notes: Drive-cycle ageing at 40 C with periodic characterisation. The characterisation blocks are exactly the periodic_rpt segments detect_rpt_segments looks for.

severson-2019.citation: Severson, K.A. et al. Data-driven prediction of battery cycle life before capacity degradation. Nature Energy 4, 383-391 (2019).
severson-2019.license: CC BY 4.0 - verify at landing page
severson-2019.name: Severson et al. fast-charging LFP cycling
severson-2019.notes: Distributed as MATLAB .mat; export per-cell CSV first. Fast-charge policies vary per cell - that is the point of the dataset, so keep the policy in the run notes.

note: Landing pages, citations and licence notes for the open cycling datasets tools/ingest_open_dataset.py knows how to ingest. Licence fields are a starting point, not a ruling: verify at the landing page before redistributing anything. The files are not in this repository; fetch them, then run `ingest <key> <dir>`.
